blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Secretariat Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura, during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday said that confidentiality is not absolute under the Anti-Money Laundering Act. Buenaventura made the remark during the interjection of Senator-judge Robin Padilla who asked if it was accurate to say that confidentiality is absolute when referring to the AMLC records. “Linawin ko lang din po kasi, kami naman sa AMLC sa Section 8, paragraph 2 may provision din po doon na we’re authorized to formulate rules,” Buenaventura said.
